title: Best Reachable Tower
summary: Given a list of towers with coordinates and quality, and a center location with a radius, find the tower with the highest quality within the radius.
statement: Given a list of towers with coordinates and quality, and a center location with a radius, find the tower with the highest quality within the radius. If multiple towers have the same quality, choose the one with the smallest lexicographical coordinates. If no tower is within the radius, return [-1, -1]. The Manhattan distance is used to determine reachability, and coordinates are compared lexicographically.
constraints: Each tower is [x,y,quality], with up to 100,000 towers.
Reachability uses Manhattan distance from center and an inclusive radius.
Choose maximum quality, breaking ties by lexicographically smallest [x,y], or return [-1,-1].
hints: Rank each reachable tower by higher quality, then smaller x, then smaller y.
A tuple (quality,-x,-y) converts that ordering into one maximum comparison.
Every tower is inspected once, and the maintained best tuple exactly represents the stated priority order.
editorial: Every tower is inspected once, and the maintained best tuple exactly represents the stated priority order.
